title: Mistral Model
description: A language model available on the Mistral AI platform, including base models and user fine-tuned models with capability and configuration metadata.

created.description: Unix timestamp when the model was created

description.description: Description of the model and its capabilities

max_context_length.description: Maximum context window length in tokens

aliases.description: Alternative names that can reference this model

deprecation.description: Deprecation date if the model is being retired

type.description: Whether this is a base platform model or a user fine-tuned model

completion_chat.description: Whether the model supports chat completions

completion_fim.description: Whether the model supports fill-in-the-middle completions

function_calling.description: Whether the model supports function calling

fine_tuning.description: Whether the model can be fine-tuned

vision.description: Whether the model supports vision/image inputs
